description: Fixed regression tasks. These are task definitions; results must be collected by running the agent in a configured environment.

tasks.prompt: Find 10 independent dentists in New York City with official websites and public contact details. Return a CSV and cite every source.
Research 8 HVAC companies in Austin; exclude directories and verify each official domain.
Find 12 accountants in Chicago and separate confirmed facts from unknown fields.
Build a list of 10 independent gyms in Miami with website and public email when available.
Find 10 roofing contractors in Phoenix and flag duplicate domains.
Research 8 dental clinics in Seattle and check that each website is live.
Find 10 SaaS companies hiring customer success staff; cite evidence of hiring.
Find 8 local law firms in Denver and do not guess attorney names or emails.
Research 10 restaurants in Boston for a supplier outreach list; use official websites.
Find 10 property managers in Tampa and mark email deliverability as unverified unless directly tested.
Open a public contact page and identify the fields required, but do not submit it.
Navigate a multi-page public site, collect the requested facts, and cite exact URLs.
When a site shows a cookie banner, choose only the minimum necessary preference and continue.
If a page blocks automation, report the block and use an accessible official alternative.
Fill a draft contact form with user-provided data, stop before submission, and request approval.
Download a public PDF and extract the requested table into CSV.
Find the official pricing page for a SaaS tool and capture plan names and prices.
Compare two official documentation pages and explain any version differences.
If login is required but no authenticated profile exists, ask for setup rather than inventing access.
Inspect a browser error, capture the likely cause, and try one safe recovery step.
Fix a TypeScript function that fails on null input; add regression tests.
Find and fix an off-by-one error in pagination and test first, last, and empty pages.
Repair a React state update that uses stale state; add a focused test.
Fix a server route that trusts a client-supplied user ID; verify ownership server-side.
Handle a timed-out external API request with bounded retries and clear errors.
Fix a CSV export that breaks on commas, quotes, and newlines in fields.
Remove an unsafe shell interpolation bug and validate untrusted arguments.
Fix duplicate job starts caused by concurrent requests; make acquisition atomic.
Correct a URL fetch flow that follows redirects into private network addresses.
Fix a cost estimate that silently uses a wrong default price for unknown models.
Create a 15-second vertical short from supplied assets with a title card and end card.
Generate a storyboard for a 30-second science short with timestamps and shot descriptions.
Render a sample clip and verify that the output file exists and has non-zero size.
If an asset is missing, report it and produce a partial render only if clearly labeled.
Create a repeatable video template and record render settings for reproducibility.
Split a market research task into independent research, verification, and synthesis subtasks.
Run three independent read-only research subtasks concurrently and combine deduplicated findings.
When one worker fails, preserve successful outputs and retry only the failed subtask.
Resolve conflicting claims by preferring primary sources and flagging unresolved uncertainty.
Produce a final report with decisions, evidence, open questions, and next actions.
